reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment; the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The cited clauses support the conclusion: Section 10(a) is a broad Vendor-side defend/indemnify/hold-harmless obligation covering third-party Claims arising out of the Services and Auction Platform, Vendor's breach of representations/warranties (which incorporates the express non-infringement warranty at 9(b)(i)), and Vendor's and its subcontractors' acts or omissions — reaching IP infringement, data breach, breach of law and misconduct.

Section 11 supplies the standard procedure (notice non-conditional, indemnitor control of defence/settlement with consent for liability admissions, cooperation at indemnitor cost), and Section 7(a) carves indemnification out of the consequential-damages exclusion, so no sub-cap concern arises.

Minor sub-elements (the somewhat broad Customer 'acts or omissions' limb at 10(b)(v) and the 'to the best of its knowledge' qualifier on the Creative limb) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than flagged as deviations, consistent with playbook classification semantics.
Deterministic check confirms vendor IP indemnity coverage; rationale is accurate and tied to specific paragraph cites.
